images.description: Health Catalyst patient chart application: Patient Details view with patient banner (Smith, John - Male, 53 Years - DOB 05/29/1970), demographics, left icon sidebar, header search, tabs (Visit History, Allergies, Medications, Diagnoses, Procedures, etc.), and visit-history table with MRN/Visit ID/Facility/Encounter Type/Diagnosis. Partly overlapped by a marketing photo in upper right.

Health Catalyst Patient Safety Monitor - Risk Prediction view. Full app: header tabs (Risk Prediction, Chart Review), facility selector, CLABSI/CAUTI/C.Diff counts, and patient rows with names (BRADFORD, JACKSON; SHAW, STEPHANIE), Visit#, Room, relative risk and modifiable risk factors.
